purpose: Measure transport of unchanged R1_A event and matched-control cash-index price responses into actual ETF traded-price series, not execution profitability.

carrier_selection_reason: One fixed plain domestic index ETF per parent index, identified from issuer/exchange records and available before the evaluation window; not selected by returns, spread, current AUM or retrospective tracking quality. Do not switch carrier after outcomes.
entry: Use the exact existing event_entry_idx and control_entry_idx, which represent next observed index 1m close after confirmation. Never regenerate or rematch on ETF data.

alignment.clock: index trading observation clock, NOT ETF row offsets or wall-clock minutes
alignment.source_start_labels: A documented source-specific conversion may be admitted before replay; do not choose shifts by correlation or PnL.

admission.hashes: SHA256, byte count and row count for every carrier delivery file; preserve raw bytes outside public Git unless redistribution is authorized.
admission.coverage_failure: INSUFFICIENT_CARRIER_COVERAGE, not alpha failure. No outcome table is authorized for a carrier until its admission and common-pair coverage pass.
admission.partial_carriers: A separately admitted carrier may be measured; the other remains blocked. Never present one carrier as both.

sample.denominator: Every frozen R1_A matched pair, including missing pairs, remains in the coverage ledger.
sample.common_primary: Require both event and control ETF prices at every index timestamp from entry through 240 bars. Use the same complete-pair sample for every horizon, and recompute index comparators on exactly that sample.
sample.zero_volume: Zero-volume carrier minutes are unavailable observed-trade prices, not free fills.
sample.corporate_actions: A complete source-backed ex-date ledger is mandatory. Exclude a pair from the common raw-price sample if either path crosses a split/distribution ex-date (entry_day < ex_date <= exit_day). Report exclusions. Do not interpret a mechanical dividend/split price drop as signal failure or apply undocumented adjustment factors.
sample.no_future_event_control_exclusions: Use the original already-frozen pairs unchanged. Do not add future-treatment filters or revise matching.

reports: close-observation MFE/MAE including zero at entry
measurements.interpretation: Descriptive historical transport on already consumed history, conditional on the inherited matching design. Same underlying exposures and overlapping dates are not independent confirmations. No fresh-OOS, causal-identification, optimized-horizon or profitability claim.

data_request: Non-event-conditioned full 2021-2025 ETF 1m OHLCV plus timestamp dictionary and complete split/distribution ex-dates. The internal anchor audit is not the default external acquisition request.
prohibitions: no ETF selection by observed outcomes
